prayerExcerpt.en-US: The highest praise which Scripture pronounces on the holy man Job is comprised in these words, "He was simple and upright."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: O mais alto louvor que a Escritura pronuncia sobre o santo homem Jó está contido nestas palavras: "Era simples e reto."

meta.face: A Byzantine noble of about seventy with a fair, lightly olive complexion and a full OVAL face — a HIGH, BALD, DOMED forehead with a single grey wisp at the top, heavy-lidded, almond-shaped dark eyes with soft pouches beneath, arched grey brows, a straight nose with a broad bridge, FULL, soft cheeks, a small, full-lipped mouth; grey-brown hair at the sides and back, falling to the nape; a LONG, WEDGE-SHAPED beard of grey-brown combed in waves and ending in a POINT at mid-chest; the gaze gentle and composed.
meta.basis: No likeness from life. The Painter's Manual gives 'vieillard, barbe en pointe', and the fourteenth-century Peribleptos fresco (Wikipedia lead image, local copy) shows a long face, a high bare forehead and a long, pointed brown-grey beard in a polystavrion; the card follows both. The book's engraving shows him mitred, rebuking the emperor. Hagia Sophia stood in his day.
